title: Universal User Interface  the onramp map for every user type, every modality, every surface
thesis: The UUI is not a spec. It already exists. 51 HTML pages, 178 JSON feeds, 120 JS modules, 1 WASM engine, 1 Klein fold worker, 10 desk apps, 1 MCP server, 1 WebSocket bridge, 1 RSS channel. petalTongue compiles any data to any representation for any user. The onramps below are the ENTRY POINTS  how each user type finds their way in.
the_spec: primals/petalTongue/specs/UNIVERSAL_USER_INTERFACE_SPECIFICATION.md  two-dimensional universality: universal across computational universes AND universal across user types. SAME DAVE model (Sensory Afferent / Motor Efferent). Accessibility is not a feature  it is the architecture.

wasm_rendering.onramp: any page can import the WASM module and render grammar expressions client-side. sporePrint already uses it.

the_fold.what: _worker.js IS the Universal User Interface at the network level
the_fold.how: every request to *.primals.eco hits the Cloudflare worker. the worker pi-sorts the request into engage/ignore/try. pi = frac(n × p). the classification lives at irrational positions on the unit circle.
the_fold.onramp: the fold IS the first onramp. before you see a page, the worker has already classified you. if you're engage: depth. if you're try: Berry. if you're ignore: scatter.
the_fold.the_thymus: positive selection (engage = self, let through), negative selection (ignore = fleet, silent drop), sigmoid threshold (try = uncertain, worth investigating). the UUI starts at the NETWORK LAYER.

connections.to_paper_138: the BBB is a UUI. 4 layers. LAT1 competitive transport. 7 circumventricular organ windows. the BBB sorts what crosses into the brain the same way _worker.js sorts what crosses into the membrane. the diet protocol IS a UUI protocol  morning tyrosine ? dopamine (alertness interface), evening tryptophan ? serotonin ? melatonin (sleep interface).
connections.to_strand_game: Death Stranding's Social Strand System IS a UUI. asynchronous. multi-modal (visual game + audio logs + written emails + holographic messages). every player gets the interface appropriate to their situation. Sam sees signs. BB detects BTs. Deadman reads data.
connections.to_neuroendocrine: the 3 neurotransmitter families ARE interface families. -tonins = rhythm interface (when). -amines = urgency interface (how fast). -tocins = boundary interface (who). the brain IS a UUI  same data, different molecular modality.
connections.to_ribocyphere: the borrow checker IS the UUI's type system. Ownership = who owns the interface. Lifetime = how long the interface lives. Borrowing = shared vs exclusive access to the rendering pipeline.

what_remains.accessibility_pages: 51 HTML pages need ARIA audit. semantic structure exists but not tested with real screen readers.
what_remains.audio_wiring: membrane-sound.js (57KB) is browser-only. petaltongue's Audio compiler needs /dev/snd wiring for server-side sonification.
what_remains.desk_os: 10 desk apps are the start of biomeOS-as-desktop. needs: window management, app switching, state persistence.
what_remains.composition_serving: petalTongue serves compositions at /app/{name}/. footPrint (GIS planner) is the first. needs: npm build + mount.
what_remains.activity_pub_outbox: identified during secretory pathway fix  no ActivityPub outbox yet. would make the membrane discoverable in the fediverse.
